# DynamicActionabilityPage: its buttons, fields and dropdowns

What the crawl saw on this page that a visitor can use (links are in
ai/GLOSSARY.md), read only: nothing was clicked, typed or sent. Each locator matched exactly one element
on the page it was read from. Those it trusts are already in `DynamicActionabilityElements`, each with the method
that uses it; a fragile one (its locator counts positions) is not, and has a line to paste into the
**elements** YOURS block once checked against a saved page (ai/recipes/add-an-element.md). Controls on most pages (a footer form) are in
controls/Everywhere.md. Not listed: anything that appears only after a click, behind a login, or
after a form is sent; ask for a saved page of that.

## In the page

- **"Prepare order"**: button. In `DynamicActionabilityElements` as `PREPARE_ORDER_BUTTON`: `click().prepareOrder()`.
- **"Submit order"**: button. In `DynamicActionabilityElements` as `SUBMIT_ORDER_BUTTON`: `click().submitOrder()`.
- **"Refresh data"**: button. In `DynamicActionabilityElements` as `REFRESH_DATA_BUTTON`: `click().refreshData()`.
- **"Export"**: button. In `DynamicActionabilityElements` as `EXPORT_BUTTON`: `click().export()`.
- **"Show offer"**: button. In `DynamicActionabilityElements` as `SHOW_OFFER_BUTTON`: `click().showOffer()`.
- **"Accept terms"**: button. In `DynamicActionabilityElements` as `ACCEPT_TERMS_BUTTON`: `click().acceptTerms()`.
